name: Alibaba Token Plan Lite

price.note: Monthly, quarterly or yearly billing. Singapore region only. New users pay $3 for the first month until 30 Nov 2026.

reset.rule: Resets to the full amount at the start of each subscription month.
stipulations: Each request costs credits based on the model, tokens, thinking mode and tool calls.
Built-in tools such as web search, web scraping and the code interpreter also use credits.
Video costs more with longer duration and higher resolution. Async tasks are charged when they finish.
Off-peak, 22:00 to 08:00 UTC+8, qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-flash cost 60% less and several DeepSeek models 50% less.
Unused credits don't roll over. There is no 5-hour or weekly limit; the weekly quota was removed on 22 Sep 2026.

overage: Buy an Extra Bundle: $15 for 20,000 credits, up to 5. Bundles last one month and are used only after the plan credits. When both run out, service pauses until the reset.

how: 20,000 credits a month, with 1 to 2 agents running at once.
A monthly credit pool only. No 5-hour or weekly window.
ext: Models from other labs: DeepSeek V4.x and GLM-5.3, alongside qwen4-max (preview), qwen3.8-max, qwen3.8-flash and Wan.
Works in interactive coding tools with the plan's own key. The console shows the base URL.
quirks: Interactive coding tools only. Scripts, backends, batch jobs, Postman or Dify can get the plan suspended or the key revoked.
No sharing. This is a separate product from the Coding Plan, with its own key and console page.
Quotas went up on every tier on 9 Nov 2026.

events.what: New-user price of $3 for the first month ends at 23:59:59 UTC+8. It applies only if your account has never bought a Token Plan.
The qwen4-max preview on the Token Plan ends.
